| Setting | Default | Choices | What it does |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Grubstake: strength | Normal | Very low (×0.5), Low (×0.75), Normal, High (×1.5), Very high (×2) | Maximum units per Grubstake base. |
| Synthexis: strength | Normal | Very low (×0.5), Low (×0.75), Normal, High (×1.5), Very high (×2) | How fast Synthexis breeds biters. |
| Grubstake: aggression | Normal | Very low (×0.5), Low (×0.75), Normal, High (×1.5), Very high (×2) | How soon and how often Grubstake attacks. |
| Synthexis: aggression | Normal | Very low (×0.5), Low (×0.75), Normal, High (×1.5), Very high (×2) | Time before Synthexis's first attack and between attacks. |
| Kessler-Hayashi: strength | Normal | Very low (×0.5), Low (×0.75), Normal, High (×1.5), Very high (×2) | Maximum units per Kessler-Hayashi base. |
| Kessler-Hayashi: aggression | Normal | Very low (×0.5), Low (×0.75), Normal, High (×1.5), Very high (×2) | How soon and how often Kessler-Hayashi attacks. |
| Chat notices | Off | On, Off | Show faction activity in chat and as alerts. First landings and destroyed bases are always shown. |

All of them are map settings: an admin can change them in a running game.
